description: This file contains a utility class 'Validators' providing various static validation methods for input fields such as email, phone number, OTP, password, and full name. It uses regular expressions for pattern matching and implements logic suited for form validation in a Flutter application.

classes.name: Validators
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for validating user input fields such as email, phone, OTP, password, and name.

methods.name: requiredText
methods.description: Validates that a given string is non-empty after trimming. Returns an error message if empty.

methods.name: phone
methods.description: Validates a phone number against a regex pattern allowing optional '+' and 8 to 15 digits.

methods.name: emailRequired
methods.description: Validates that an email is non-empty and matches the email regex pattern.

methods.name: emailOptional
methods.description: Validates that an optional email, if provided, matches the email regex pattern.

methods.name: phoneOrEmail
methods.description: Validates that input is either a valid phone number or email address.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Validates that a password is at least 8 characters, contains at least one letter and one number, and has no spaces.

methods.name: otp
methods.description: Validates OTP codes consisting of 4-8 digits.

methods.name: fullNameOptional
methods.description: Validates optional full name input; if provided, must be at least 2 characters.
